text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The Centaur Stakes draws near.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As for Believe and me...
frankly speaking, we were in a pretty severe situation.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Phew, phew, whew...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Just one more rep—
choice_data_list: ...No. Let's call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When running races in quick succession, the first priority is
recovering from the toll taken in the opening bout and conserving stamina.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To prevent injury, I can't budge on this.
After the Kitakyushu Kinen, any intense physical movement
is strictly prohibited, even during voluntary training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Instead—
choice_data_list: I'll send you the footage from today's training later.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Understood. I will check.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
How to use her body. How to move.
I'll watch closely... down to the finest detail.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I leave it to you.
Yeah, I leave it to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since she can't use her body, I'm having Believe use
her head quite a bit. To make up for not being able to handle
high volume, we focus on highly effective training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Focus your senses into every fiber of your being,
so that even from a single sprint,
you get far more out of it than usual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, in a nutshell――
that might just be the equivalent of burning through mental stamina instead of physical stamina, though.
choice_data_list: (Honestly, the mental strain is pretty rough...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You adjust yourself so that your mental and physical condition peaks right at the main event.
That is how it is supposed to be done.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, if she runs on a tighter schedule, that changes things considerably.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Simply put, we can't let our energy drop.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I need her to maintain that peak level of focus—
a mental state strung taut to the verge of snapping.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What's more... Believe didn't set any target races for her Junior year. Meaning, she doesn't have much actual race experience. And yet—
choice_data_list: (Running three races with so little rest in between...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just because she looks unfazed doesn't mean she actually is. —I know that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watching Believe exhale even more slowly than usual, I turn directly toward her and speak.
choice_data_list: See you tomorrow. I'm counting on you, Believe.
See you tomorrow. I'm counting on you, okay, Believe?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
See you at work tomorrow.
...I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Crush all doubts and hesitations and swallow them whole.
'Just endure and hold out until we win'—
believing that is their true style.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ...Ah.
I walked right past my room...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I'm... overthinking things.
Lately, I've been sleeping lightly...
and it's even been a little hard to swallow my food—)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Believe?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Light O-san.
...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I spoke up because that was a pretty heavy sigh.
I mean, you've been looking a bit worn out lately.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —Looks like she put together quite the packed race schedule.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, well.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I was actually quite surprised. When I heard that you would be entering the Centaur Stakes as well.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "Calstone-san is... running too, right? In the Centaur Stakes."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
By the way, just so you know, I'm full of energy
and in peak condition! I even took 1st place in my last graded race.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...That is a wonderful thing.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Believe.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I won't worry.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —There is no need.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Heh. ...Figures.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Not needed. Neither excuses nor circumstances.
Our contest is always remarkably simple.
A straight line toward the answer.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: The answer—in other words, who is faster.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That is all.
Nothing else is needed between us.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right, Believe?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Let's settle this, Daitaku Helios-san.
